myth_screen: Downstream agents MUST screen every statistic against this never-cite table (verbatim from PSYCHOLOGY.md; if a draft reaches for one of these, use the allowed substitute or cut the number): "2,000% from free samples" = refuted/untraceable -> say "sampling lifts short-term purchases, magnitude category-dependent (~70-600% same-day)"; "70-90% never change defaults" = unsourced blend -> "defaults are directionally powerful (d=0.68 meta-analysis)"; "losses hurt exactly 2x" = contested -> "~1.3-2.0x, stake-dependent, weak at small stakes"; jam study as "fewer options convert better" = failed replication -> "overload needs moderators; fix comparability (d~0.02)"; "$300M button"/ASOS guest checkout = marketing anecdote -> "Baymard 19-24% forced-account abandonment"; "5% retention = +25-95% profit" = 1990s banking, no beauty basis -> "measure Solen's own cohort margins"; "retention 5-25x cheaper than acquisition" = untraceable -> "use our own CAC vs repeat-margin"; "Amazon 100ms = 1% sales" = unpublished anecdote -> "Google/Deloitte 2020: +0.1s = +8.4% conversion (37 sites, production)"; Duolingo "+20% DAU from delayed signup" = single self-report -> "directional; A/B our own funnel"; "UGC contributors return 4x more" = untraceable -> "engaged contributors 11% vs 42% dormancy (Marketing Science)". Also: left-digit pricing (.90/.95) is a VALUES call that conflicts with Swiss round-CHF trust convention — never introduce silently, owner-only. Any in-file PSYCHOLOGY number cited standalone must carry the "full sources: research/PSYCH_*.md" pointer or be verified to its primary paper first (law 1 r=.58, law 2 d=0.68/n=73k, law 3 19%->34%, law 8 50-100ms, law 13 66 days are all un-named inline).
dedup_notes: Deliberately EXCLUDED from canon-deepen because the coverage reports show them strong AND sourced (re-researching would waste the round): visual hierarchy / scanning patterns (F-shape, layer-cake, zigzag, spotted — all T1 NN/g in TASTE_HIERARCHY); typography level-count / size-ceilings / stacked-emphasis (T1/T2 in TASTE_TYPOGRAPHY); Gestalt grouping + card-vs-list-vs-divider decision tree + nesting limits (T1/T2 in TASTE_GROUPING); Fitts / Hick (RATIONALE §1 base layer); contrast math incl. WCAG 2.2 AA + APCA supplement with measured tokens (RATIONALE §3, the single strongest-sourced area of SOURCE.md §16); Nielsen 10 heuristics + heuristic-evaluation procedure + 0-4 severity scale (T1, feeds D10 but the vocabulary itself is settled); geometry / symmetry / optical-alignment / proportion / grid-math (the 85-principle GEOMETRY_PRINCIPLES audit is exhaustive — mechanize its open R3/R5/R6 debts via D-streams, do NOT re-research the theory); checkout/payment forms (Baymard+NN/g, TASTI_CHECKOUT strong) and dashboards/data-display (NN/g + peer-reviewed, TASTE_DASHBOARDS strong) — feed these into net-new only via their unclosed edges (TWINT/local-payment UI, real-time dashboards), not a re-run. Also EXCLUDED as un-sourceable per prior searches (do NOT reopen): channel-strength ranking (which cue wins — no valid percentage exists, never cite one), Z-pattern scanning (folk convention, no NN/g primary), faces/gaze-cueing (no fetchable primary). All ~15 conversion/retention laws are OWNED by PSYCHOLOGY.md — no stream re-derives them; behavioral streams carry an xref and only exist where a PERCEPTUAL/mechanics angle is left for RATIONALE.
